case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. [NUMBER] OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) No. 12656 OF 2022)

parties.petitioner: Veena Vadini Teachers Training Institute (RUN BY Veena Vadini Samaj Kalyan Vikash Samiti)

summary: Challenge to state reservation policy for B.Ed (Part-time) course admissions; 75% seats reserved for MP residents contested as violative of Articles 14, 15, 19(1)(g); High Court dismissal upheld based on precedent (Preston College 2007); issue: applicability of residence-based reservation doctrine from medical education cases (Pradeep Jain 1984) to teacher training programs; State interest and regional backwardness examined as justifications; unfilled MP quotas noted but policy upheld as constitutionally permissible under established precedents despite low admissions from reserved quota.
legal_provisions_cited: Dr. Pradeep Jain and Others v. Union of India and Others (1984) 3 SCC 654
D.P. Joshi v. State of Madhya Pradesh (1955) 1 SCR 1215
Saurabh Chaudhari and Others v. Union of India and Others (2003) 11 SCC 146
Magan Mehrotra and Others v. Union of India and Others (2003) 11 SCC 186
Rajdeep Ghosh v. The State of Assam (2018) 17 SCC 524
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; challenge to reservation policy rejected; High Court's order upholding 75% reservation for MP residents in B.Ed (Part-time) admissions upheld; unfilled seats in MP quota cannot be reallocated to outside candidates; policy deemed constitutionally valid.
